usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/wan-2.6/t2v with JSON body {prompt, duration?, resolution?}. Pay x402 USDC on Base (~$0.50 observed for 5s/720p; registry surface $10 is the cap, not the charge). Returns async job {success, jobId, status:"pending", type:"wan-2.6-t2v"}. Then poll the result with SIWX auth (free, no payment): GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} every ~15-25s until status="complete".
usage.outputShape: POST response: body.jobId (string), body.status ("pending"), body.success (true), body.type ("wan-2.6-t2v"). Poll response (GET /api/jobs/{jobId}, SIWX): body.status ("loading"|"complete"|"failed"), body.progress, body.error, and on success body.result.videoUrl + body.result.thumbnailUrl.
quirks: This is the t2v (TEXT-to-video) route - unlike its i2v sibling it needs NO image, only a prompt. Do not send an 'image' field.

Two-step async: POST returns {jobId, status:'pending'} only. The finished video is NOT in the POST response. You MUST poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} until status='complete', then read body.result.videoUrl.

POLL IS SIWX, NOT PAID: GET /api/jobs/{jobId} requires a SIGN-IN-WITH-X (CAIP-122 wallet signature) header and is free (no USDC). Use --siwx / agentcash fetch handles it. Without a signature it returns 402 with a sign-in-with-x extension.
DYNAMIC PRICING: registry surface says $10.00 but that is the cap/max; actual charge observed $0.50 for 5s 720p. x402 USDC on Base.
duration enum '5'|'10'|'15' (string), resolution '720p'|'1080p'. enablePromptExpansion defaults true server-side.
Test completed fast (~60s) but video models can take 2-5 min; poll every ~15s. Do NOT resubmit while status is 'pending'/'loading' - duplicate submissions create duplicate paid jobs.
Result videoUrl/thumbnailUrl are Vercel Blob URLs that expire after ~20 minutes - download the video immediately on completion.
Canonical origin stablestudio.dev works; the .io host serves the same API.
usage.guide: Wan 2.6 text-to-video. STEP 1: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/wan-2.6/t2v with JSON {prompt, duration?, resolution?} (no image needed - this is the t2v route); pay USDC on Base (~$0.50, not the $10 surface). You get back {jobId, status:'pending'}. STEP 2: poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with a SIGN-IN-WITH-X (SIWX) signature header (free, not a payment) every ~15s until status='complete', then read the video at body.result.videoUrl and download it within ~20 min before the URL expires. Never resubmit while pending/loading.
